help: Lighting, material, shadow and image-quality features for Fallout 4 VR.

content.text: Community Shaders at Home (CSAH) VR adds lighting, material, shadow and image-quality features to Fallout 4 VR. A change shows in the game as you make it; Save keeps it in CSAH.toml, and Discard or closing the menu restores the saved value. Settings marked for a restart take effect at the next game launch.
The visual suite, DLAA / DLSS, Vanilla Fixes and Native Shadows have independent switches on the Features page.

content.help: The visual suite, DLAA/DLSS, Vanilla Fixes, and Native Shadows have independent master gates.
Controls only the lighting, material, shadow, and output effects in this suite. DLAA/DLSS, Vanilla Fixes, and Native Shadows retain their own settings and continue independently.
Evaluates supported lighting and material colour operations in linear space.
Master gate for the shared validated environment used by Dynamic Cubemaps and Diffuse IBL.
Uses the shared stereo scene environment for position-aware specular reflections while retaining each material's vanilla cubemap as the confidence fallback.
Adds environment-derived diffuse bounce lighting.
Uses a shared stereo world-space probe field to occlude sky diffuse and specular light beneath roofs, trees, and overhangs.
Keeps native directional lighting and shadows aligned with the actual Sun by day and Fallout's single climate-enabled Moon by night.
Replaces the exact native HDR blend with hue-preserving highlight compression while retaining bloom, cinematic state, fade, and engine adaptation.
Applies day, night and interior colour tables and the colour controls to the finished image, inside the output pass the game already draws.
Adds a stereo-isolated HDR mip-chain bloom while preserving Fallout's native bloom.
Convolves bright HDR light with a wavelength-dependent optical point-spread function independently for each eye.
Not working. Disabled by default. This setting controls Volumetric Lighting / Godrays.
Uses finite-source inverse-square falloff for deferred and tiled local lights. Keeps native radii, spot cones, shadows and gameplay detection unchanged.
Adds an exterior height-dependent fog layer using current weather colours. Works without enabling Volumetric Lighting.
Screen Space AO and GI. While on, it replaces Stereo SAO, which then stays off whatever VrAllowSAO says.
Requires Linear Lighting. Uses one energy-conserving GGX/Fresnel material response for direct light, IBL, dynamic cubemaps, wetness, and the native reflection fallback.
Enables complex-material environment response when validated IBL data is available.
Enables parallax on assets authored for the CSAH complex-material contract.
Applies the manual wet-state material response to classified wettable surfaces.
Enables the selected water surface and underwater lighting effects.
Uses alpha heights in compatible water normal maps to displace their texture sampling.
Modulates sunlight below the native exterior-cell water planes.

Adds the shared dynamic cubemap to water only. Off keeps dynamic cubemaps available to other materials. Independent of FX 10.5 Water Reflections; enable both to combine them. Requires global Dynamic Cubemaps and Water Effects.

Screen-space water reflections, independently toggleable from Water Dynamic Cubemaps. Works alone with that switch off, or combines with it when both are on. Requires Water Effects; global Dynamic Cubemaps is optional.
Blends shifted terrain texture samples to reduce visible repetition.
Enables independent terrain and distant-object colour adjustment. Neutral values preserve the original colours.
Adds short-range screen-space directional occlusion.
Projects captured cloud cover along the directional light.
Distant terrain shadows from generated worldspace heightmaps. Missing maps preserve native sunlight.
Independent from the CSAH visual suite; restart required.
Independent Streamline image-quality master. It can remain enabled while the CSAH visual suite and Vanilla Fixes are disabled.
Independent master for the verified FO4VR renderer corrections. It does not require the CSAH visual suite or DLAA/DLSS. Restart after changing this master.

content.help: World-space DFLight integration extracts shafts from local shadow contrast. Native fog remains authoritative, and unsafe output stays pass-through.
Adds broad volumetric haze. Zero preserves Fallout's native fog and is the safe default.
The enhanced bloom is extracted from the verified linear HDR scene before exposure and tonemapping. It is added to, not substituted for, Fallout's native bloom.
Each eye receives an independent FFT convolution. Higher FFT resolution sharpens the diffraction pattern and increases fixed GPU cost.

content.help: Runs only while Screen Space GI is off.

Enables FO4VR screen-space reflections with per-eye traversal, geometric reflection rays, shared world-radiance retention, and corrected cubemap fallback. Water uses separate shaders and is not changed.
Controls Bethesda's shared native SSS and reflection image-space pipeline. It can change SSR and Dynamic Cubemap capture.
Prevents a peripheral Sun query from forcing the shared glare visibility to fully occluded while another completed query still has valid coverage.

Read-only measurements; both eyes still render normally. Requires tracked ambient lighting (Linear Lighting or Skylighting). Logs per-surface buffer agreement, sampled native material draw costs, and GPU spans to CSAH.log. Ordinary class includes untagged pixels; timings cover whole native draw calls, not isolated right-eye shading. Adds diagnostic GPU work while enabled; turn off after the comparison. Leave GPU Performance Profiling Off to isolate these timings.
Writes continuous image-neutral GPU and CPU submission timings for the selected expensive feature group. Off disables timing collection, including startup captures.

Exclusive test view. Modes 1-11 retain the directional-light ownership tests. Modes 12 and 13 expose the packed DFComposite direct-diffuse or direct-specular buffer. Modes 14 and 15 use the exact four live reflection-composite permutations to publish their already-computed native SSR or uncorrected stock-cubemap value, without fallback or material modulation. Fallout's required shared material producer graph remains active, unrelated DFComposite contracts render black, and CSAH presentation features are suppressed. Saved feature settings are preserved. This choice is also available before launch under [Diagnostics] in CSAH.toml.
